verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a password manager that stores one-time codes, but the pack never documents the 1Password mobile app locking itself behind biometrics or a PIN, nor any auto-lock behavior that would protect codes on a borrowed phone. The only biometric mention covers signing in to the CLI with Touch ID or Windows Hello through the desktop app integration. That is a different surface and does not show the app itself locks.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app itself locks behind biometrics or a PIN, so a borrowed phone doesn't expose my codes
